rule: Mark confirmed only when a public repository explicitly reuses the same Starlette issue or fix as an LLM, agent, benchmark, code-repair, or evaluation task, or highly copies that task or patch. Ordinary downstream references, vendored source, production workarounds, and repository names that merely contain words such as agent do not count.
query_patterns: GitHub code search for the exact quoted path starlette/issues/<number> and starlette/pull/<number> across public repositories
Manual inspection of repositories or paths containing benchmark, eval, LLM, SWE, repair, dataset, TeamBench, CS540, or repo-issue markers
Previously discovered exact GitHub cross-references for the registered Issue and PR set

limitations: GitHub code search is index-based, capped per query, and cannot prove absence. The scan covers public GitHub state observed on 2026-08-23, uses exact source-path discovery plus manual inspection, and records no_public_hit_found rather than claiming no contamination.
